tickets.title: Prepare first-year education funding source comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side schedule showing how Lena Pebblefizz’s Velvet Acorn Custody 529 account, the household’s $28,000 education savings CD at Teacup Comet Bank, taxable account sales, and household cash could cover the first academic year at Thimble Harbor University while preserving the $50,000 cash reserve floor.
